prose: Dr. Thomas Zinser is a hypnotherapist and soul-retriever with decades of experience in treating dissociative and split personality patients. We explore comparisons between sub-personalities and stuck biofield energy, how sub-personalities are formed through trauma, using ideo-motor response communication to speak with alternate egos, healing through psychic coalescence, and Tom's work training the next wave of soul defragmenters.
ext: We describe the corporate structure of demonic hierarchy, types of mischievous spirits, dark souls, and how they influence living humans through possession and demonic devices, how Tom met his guide Gerod, and the distinction between evil and darkness.
